title: LRG GIST Patient Registry
official: Life Raft Group GIST Registry Protocol
summary: The Life Raft Group (LRG) Patient Registry is a structured database that collects comprehensive information about individuals diagnosed with GIST. The purpose of this registry is to facilitate research, improve understanding of the disease, track patient outcomes, and ultimately enhance patient care.
criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

1. Gastrointestinal Stromal Tumor diagnosis
2. Provide written and informed consent
